title: pivotkit view file, format version 1
description: A pivotkit view (the report's layout as JSON) with what a person and another pivotkit need to know about it. Readers ignore keys they do not know; a newer formatVersion or view.version is refused. See https://pivotkit.eize.dev/reference/view-file/

format.description: Marks a view file; a document without it is read as a bare view.

formatVersion.description: The version of this envelope. A reader refuses a newer one.

name.description: What the view shows, for people. Plain text, at most 256 characters.

description.description: More about the view, for people. Plain text, at most 2,000 characters; left out when empty.

createdAt.description: When the file was written, in UTC (ISO 8601). Optional: a file without it is the same bytes on every export.

generator.description: The program that wrote the file.

source.description: The data the view was made for.

id.description: The host's stable name of the data ("sales").

fields.description: The fields of the data the view uses (rows, columns, values, filters, sort; a grouping as its source field), with their types.

extensions.description: Reserved for hosts: their own data under a key of their own (a domain or a package name). pivotkit ignores it.

view.description: The view itself, with its own version (pivotkit-core's View). Every reader passes it through normalize() against its data.

filters.description: The filters, applied together (and). Each names a field and its type; normalize() checks the rest. A reader that does not know a type reports that filter as an unused part and leaves it out.

field.description: A column of the data or a grouping of the view.

type.description: The filter's type. The types this version knows are listed; another one (a newer pivotkit's) is valid here, and a reader that does not know it reports it as unused.

then.description: The item itself compared: a number (a grouping's key, year 2022, month 202503) or a date as its calendar day ("2022-03-01"); value2 with between and notBetween.

value.description: A number (also as text, "2022") or a date "2022-03-01".

then.description: The dates of the last count years, months or days, today's included, on a date field or a grouping of one; today is the reader's.
